The manual route

Doing it yourself

  1. Open Audio MIDI Setup and create a multi-output device.
  2. Add both displays to it and confirm the sample rates match.
  3. Select the new device as the system output.

What you give up

  • Both panels receive the same signal rather than a split pair.
  • Volume keys may stop controlling the aggregate device.
  • The arrangement has to be rebuilt when a display is reconnected.

A closing note about when the manual approach is worth it.
